mapper.sql: p.id, p.product_no AS productNo, p.name, p.mnemonic, p.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, p.unit_id AS unitId, u.name AS unitName, p.stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, p.cost_price AS costPrice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_sku s WHERE s.product_id = p.id AND s.delete_flag = '0') AS skuCount, (SELECT pr.price FROM product_price pr JOIN product_sku s2 ON s2.id = pr.sku_id AND s2.delete_flag = '0' WHERE pr.product_id = p.id AND pr.price_type = '1' AND pr.unit_id = 0 AND pr.delete_flag = '0' AND pr.enabled = 1 ORDER BY s2.id LIMIT 1) AS purchasePrice, (SELECT pr.price FROM product_price pr JOIN product_sku s3 ON s3.id = pr.sku_id AND s3.delete_flag = '0' WHERE pr.product_id = p.id AND pr.price_type = '2' AND pr.unit_id = 0 AND pr.delete_flag = '0' AND pr.enabled = 1 ORDER BY s3.id LIMIT 1) AS retailPrice, (SELECT pr.price FROM product_price pr JOIN product_sku s4 ON s4.id = pr.sku_id AND s4.delete_flag = '0' WHERE pr.product_id = p.id AND pr.price_type = '3' AND pr.unit_id = 0 AND pr.delete_flag = '0' AND pr.enabled = 1 ORDER BY s4.id LIMIT 1) AS salePrice, (SELECT pr.price FROM product_price pr JOIN product_sku s5 ON s5.id = pr.sku_id AND s5.delete_flag = '0' WHERE pr.product_id = p.id AND pr.price_type = '4' AND pr.unit_id = 0 AND pr.delete_flag = '0' AND pr.enabled = 1 ORDER BY s5.id LIMIT 1) AS lowPrice, p.status, p.enable_serial_number AS enableSerialNumber, p.enable_batch_number AS enableBatchNumber, p.create_time AS createTime

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product ( product_no, category_id, name, mfrs, brand, mnemonic, unit_id, expiry_num, weight, stock_quantity, cost_price, img_name, remark, status, enable_serial_number, enable_batch_number, delete_flag, deleted_token, created_by, updated_by, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{productNo}, #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{mfrs}, #{brand}, #{mnemonic}, #{unitId}, #{expiryNum}, #{weight}, COALESCE(#{stockQuantity}, 0), #{costPrice}, #{imgName}, #{remark}, #{status}, #{enableSerialNumber}, #{enableBatchNumber}, '0', '0', #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET product_no = #{productNo}, category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, mfrs = #{mfrs}, brand = #{brand}, mnemonic = #{mnemonic}, unit_id = #{unitId}, expiry_num = #{expiryNum}, weight = #{weight}, stock_quantity = COALESCE(#{stockQuantity}, 0), cost_price = #{costPrice}, img_name = #{imgName}, remark = #{remark}, status = #{status}, enable_serial_number = #{enableSerialNumber}, enable_batch_number = #{enableBatchNumber}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_flag = '0'
UPDATE product SET status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_flag = '0'
UPDATE product SET delete_flag = '1', deleted_token = #{deletedToken}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_flag = '0'
